reflection.text:
Unblinded truth: AZ-U / Epithelial. Agent call: Epithelial p=0.58 correct, protocol 3/4 wells Epithelial (summed similarity 2.401) vs 1/4 Protein synthesis. Verdict approve is warranted.

What evidence got right:
- Quantitative morphology dose-dependence over 4 acquired wells (1, 3, 10, 30 uM): frac_large_nucleus rho=+1.00 p=0 e9 with z = +8.7 at 1 uM e3 -> +20.0 at 3 uM e8 -> +23.0 at 10 uM e7 -> +59.3 at 30 uM e2; frac_multinucleate_proxy rho=+1.00 e16 and frac_mitotic_like rho=+1.00 e10 parallel; act_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 e12 (+9.8 -> +16.0 -> +21.7 -> +77.8) and tub_mean rho=+1.00 e11 (+5.9 -> +9.7 -> +11.9 plus e2 tub_glcm_contrast +43.8), act_mean rho=+1.00 e17. This monotonic, extreme texture increase is consistent with cytoskeletal remodeling and large/multinucleate syncytia formation, not a transient artifact. Image-based phenotypic profiling for MoA grouping is supported as a general approach PMID 27434125 and PMID 40840446, PMID 39745025.
- Atlas comparison: initial NSC 1/2 Epithelial e6 (k-neighbours Epithelial 4/10, Protein synthesis 4/10, Eg5 2/10) was ambiguous, but after sampling 10 uM and 3 uM, updated NSC 3/4 Epithelial e13 (k-neighbours 5/10 Epithelial, 3/10 Protein synthesis, 2/10 Eg5) with per-well similarities 0.773 at 1 uM, 0.813 at 3 uM, 0.815 at 10 uM protocol - all Epithelial. That majority vote override was correctly weighted in update_hypotheses e19.
- Cell count rho=-1.00 e14 (1036 cells at 1 uM e3 -> 859 at 3 uM e8 -> 661 at 10 uM e7 -> 114 at 30 uM e2) plus nuc_solidity rho=-1.00 e15 indicating irregular nuclei, argued against simple proliferation/pro-epithelial hyperplasia and for dose-dependent toxicity with cytokinesis failure phenotype.
- Tub_mean increase e11 directly contradicted microtubule destabilizer (hypothesis prob 0.01) and helped down-weight DNA damage/replication (0.005/0.003) which would not produce tub/actin z >10-70.

What misled or was incompletely resolved, and why:
- Microscopist describe_phenotype conflict: e4 (density higher vs DMSO, candidates Aurora kinase inhibitors/Microtubule stabilizers) vs e5 (density lower vs DMSO, candidates Actin disruptors). Acquired well counts and e14 rho=-1.00 show density truly decreases with dose, so e4 was sampling noise from 2 fields at an intermediate/low dose field and over-interpreted large-nuclei as Aurora. This temporarily inflated Aurora (0.15) and Microtubule stabilizer (0.08) hypotheses e19.
- High-dose acquisition choice e2 (30 uM, 114 cells left, z+77.8/+59.3/+43.8) is in cytotoxic collapse regime. Protocol shows this single well nearest = Protein synthesis similarity 0.676, not Epithelial, explaining residual Protein synthesis 3/10 k-neighbours even at e13. We acquired the extreme first with mid-dose, which was good for range-finding but without it we would have had 3/3 Epithelial; with it we correctly kept p=0.58 not >0.9.
- Actin/tubulin texture z-scores alone mimicked Aurora/Eg5: e4/e5 candidates and Eg5 k-neighbours 2/10 at both e6 and e13 reflect shared mitotic/multinucleate morphology. Dose-response alone cannot separate Aurora-induced polyploidy from epithelial cytokinesis failure without secondary markers - noted in rationale.
- Paradoxical nuc_area rho=-1.00 e18 vs frac_large_nucleus rho=+1.00 e9 was not resolved. It suggests segmentation defines fewer but more irregular / fragmented nuclei at high dose, compatible with decreased solidity e15, but we lacked a nuclear envelope segmentation control and did not acquire 0.1-0.3 uM wells to test onset shape.
- Compound lookup e21: AZ-U is BBBC021 internal code with no PubChem CID/ChEMBL mechanism, and literature searches e22 "BBBC021 phenotypic profiling breast cancer epithelial" 0 hits, e23 "multinucleated syncytia polyploidy large nuclei Aurora cytokinesis" 0 hits. No chemical or literature prior could anchor the call - reliance on image profile was appropriate.

Acquisition lessons: listing e1 8 doses 0.01-30 uM 4/4 wells left and then sampling 30, 1, 10, 3 uM covered onset (z~9 at 1 uM) to saturation (z~77 at 30 uM) enabling Spearman rho=1.0 tests. Four wells were sufficient for NSC majority; adding 0.3 uM would not have changed vote given 1 uM already Epithelial 0.773.

Next experiment as proposed - E-cadherin/EMT IHC and live cytokinesis imaging at 1,3,10 uM vs reference Epithelial - directly tests solidity/multinucleate mechanism versus Aurora off-target.
what_was_right: e9/e16/e10 rho=+1.00 large nuclei/multinucleate/mitotic-like plus e12/e17/e11 actin/tubulin increase, with extreme z at 30uM e2, correctly flagged polyploid/syncytial cytoskeletal phenotype
e13 NSC 3/4 Epithelial with high per-well similarities 0.773/0.813/0.815 (protocol) vs e6 1/2 ambiguous, correctly promoted Epithelial to 0.58 e19
